_provenance.note: Two real halves, spliced. Nothing here is invented.

envelope.how: claude 2.1.263 run interactively in a pty from an empty temp dir with --setting-sources "" --strict-mcp-config --settings <throwaway file registering a PreToolUse hook, matcher AskUserQuestion, that appends stdin to a file>. No live agent config was read or written.
envelope.finding: PreToolUse DOES fire for AskUserQuestion, and it fires while the question dialog is still open and unanswered — i.e. during the turn that never ends. It does NOT fire in print (-p) mode: AskUserQuestion is absent from the tool list there.
envelope.caveat: The captured session ran with transcript saving off (inherited CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION), so its transcript_path may not exist on disk. The path shape is real; the file is not guaranteed.

tool_input.source: a real AskUserQuestion tool_use block from ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl
tool_input.why: The live capture's own tool_input had 2 options and no preview. This one carries 3 options and a preview on each, so it exercises the fields the emitter has to survive. Same shape as the captured one, field for field.

questions.question: How should archived plans render in the plans tab?

options.label: Collapsed “Archived” group
options.description: Archived plans appear as their own group (reusing the existing collapsible SourceGroup), default-collapsed at the bottom of the project source. Strongest declutter; one click to expand history. Server exposes archived/ as a sub-group.

options.label: Dimmed rows + badge
options.description: Archived plans stay in the same flat list but are muted and tagged with an 'archived' badge (like the QA review/run marker). Less declutter — they still take list space — but no expand/collapse needed.

options.label: Filter toggle
options.description: A control in the filter/sort bar (Show archived: on/off), default off. Archived hidden until toggled. Maximal declutter, but the history is invisible by default and needs discovery.
